channel.title: ESMA publications
channel.description: European Securities and Markets Authority publications

item.title: Final Report — Draft RTS and ITS on securitisation reporting
item.description: ESMA final report on the draft regulatory and implementing technical standards on disclosure requirements under Article 7 of the Securitisation Regulation, covering the underlying exposures reporting templates.

item.title: Securitisation reporting technical standards — XML schema and instructions (version 1.3.1)
item.description: Updated reporting templates, XML schema and technical reporting instructions for securitisation disclosure. Includes the non-ABCP underlying exposure report XSD and the disclosure template workbook.

item.title: ESMA publishes latest edition of its Spotlight on Markets newsletter
item.description: The newsletter covers ESMA's recent supervisory convergence work, speeches and staff appointments.

item.title: Consultation Paper on amendments to the securitisation disclosure templates
item.description: ESMA seeks views on proposed changes to the Article 7 disclosure templates for underlying exposures, including simplification of residential real estate reporting fields. Responses close 2026-05-15.

item.title: Questions and Answers on the Securitisation Regulation — disclosure templates
item.description: New Q&A clarifying how to complete residential real estate underlying exposure fields, including the use of no-data options ND1 to ND5 where a value is not collected.

item.title: ESMA report on the securitisation market in the European Union
item.description: Statistical overview of issuance volumes and outstanding balances across the European securitisation market.
